title: Staff cannot log in - identity provider idp-02:8443 unreachable
explanation: Repeated connection timeouts to the IdP and every login failing with UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT. Clinicians are locked out of all systems (shift change).
action: Fail over to secondary IdP, check idp-02; clinical lead activates downtime procedures / break-glass accounts.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: Identity provider reachable again - logins restored
action: Post-mortem: single IdP dependency for both auth nodes.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: Database connection leak - pool at 75% and rising
explanation: Pool usage rises steadily (~1 pt / 10 min) during the day: a connection leak. At this pace the pool is exhausted in a few hours and the electronic health record stops.
action: DBA/on-call: find the leaking client, recycle pool BEFORE exhaustion.

title: No lab results for 15 min
explanation: Normal daytime rate is ~1 result/min. Results (troponin, INR, CBC) are not reaching clinicians. The HL7 connection to the analyser gateway was closed at 10:47 (logged only as DEBUG). Hourly stats still show 0 errors.
action: Restart HL7 listener / check analyser gateway; lab phones critical results until restored.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: Patient personal data written to logs (GDPR)
explanation: Full name, civil ID and date of birth appear in log field 'ctx' after a config reload to verbose logging. Logs may already be replicated.
action: Notify DPO (72h GDPR clock), purge/mask logs in all copies, revert verbose log_ctx and review deploy-bot change.

title: Verbose logging reverted - PII no longer written
explanation: 12 log lines contained PII. Purge still required.
action: Complete log purge and DPO assessment.

title: Lab results flowing again
action: Review delayed critical results (troponin, INR) with clinicians.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: Electronic health record failing - DB pool exhausted
explanation: Clinical-record cannot get DB connections (E-DB-0412); clinicians cannot open patient records.
action: Recycle DB pool now; clinical lead activates paper downtime procedure.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: Memory leak - scheduling heap 63.3%, out-of-memory expected ~26/11 01:54
explanation: Heap grows 2.6 pts/h and accelerating, never recovered by GC; projected exhaustion in 11.9 h. Other JVMs are stable at 41-49%.
action: Heap dump + controlled restart in a low-traffic window before ETA; fix the leak.

title: Admissions events backing up - queue at 46
explanation: Queue grew in 10/12 intervals over the last hour (produced > consumed). It will not drain on its own; admission/bed events are delayed.

title: Prescriptions issued WITHOUT dose checking
explanation: dose_check='bypass' (never seen before today). Risk of medication error. Pharmacy stock sync is failing at the same time (1 partial syncs).
action: Pharmacist double-checks every new prescription; restore pharmacy sync; retrospective review of affected prescriptions.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: DB pool reinitialised - patient records available
explanation: Manual pool reinit by on-call. Root cause (leak) NOT fixed.
action: Mandatory follow-up: find connection leak to avoid recurrence.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: Dose checking active again
explanation: 38 prescriptions were issued without dose check - each must be reviewed.
action: Pharmacy retrospective review of listed patient_refs.
sla: Alert <1 min, ack <=5 min, mitigation <=15 min

title: Release 2.14.0 broke /appointments/confirm
explanation: New error 'NullPointerException in SlotMapper' appeared only after deploy 2.13.4 -> 2.14.0 at 16:40 and keeps recurring. Load balancer health checks stay green.
action: Roll back to 2.13.4; inform patients/front desk.
